usage_title: MyFox is a toolkit for installing and maintaining the official Firefox with MyFox tweaks: update, reinstall, start and restart, uninstall.
cmd_browser: Launch the installed browser (extra arguments go to Firefox)
cmd_restart: Restart the browser with its windows and tabs (not running: just start it)
cmd_refresh: Update the tweaks, the themes, the bookmarklet styling and MyFox (--force: forced update)
cmd_reinstall: Reinstall Firefox and apply the tweaks
err_installdir_empty: The install directory can't be empty.
err_installdir_foreign: '{0}' already has files in it that aren't MyFox's.
err_installdir_cannot_create: '{0}' isn't writable, so the install directory can't be created there.
progress_network_silent: {0} no answer from the network: {1} of {2} s
err_network_silent: No answer from the network for {0} s; the download is stopped.
install_cancelled: The install is cancelled; what it had created is removed.
install_done_run: Launch: «Firefox» in the applications menu («Firefox with the MyFox tweaks»), or myfox browser
err_import_in_use: First close the Firefox that has the profile «{0}» open.
warn_import_downgrade: The profile was last opened by Firefox {0}, newer than {1} being installed, and may not work right. Press Install again to go on at your own risk.
warn_import_downgrade_cli: The profile was last opened by Firefox {0}, newer than {1} being installed, and may not work right. To go on at your own risk: --allow-downgrade
refresh_restart_firefox: Restart Firefox to apply the update
note_plasma_pkg_missing: KDE Plasma integration needs the system package «plasma-browser-integration». Install it: {0}
note_plasma_pkg_missing_manual: KDE Plasma integration needs the system package «plasma-browser-integration»; install it with your package manager.
note_plasma_addon_failed: Could not download the Plasma Integration add-on from addons.mozilla.org.
note_gui_failed: Could not install the graphical interface ({0}): MyFox windows won't open, the terminal commands work.
note_pin_failed: Could not tie the MyFox profile to this Firefox: Firefox didn't start (missing system libraries?). Firefox may open another profile; run `myfox reinstall` once it starts.
reinstall_keeps_profile: The profile (bookmarks, history, settings) stays as it is.
needs_yes_uninstall_profile: To delete the profile as well: {0}
needs_yes_uninstall_keep_sync: To leave the Firefox account in MyFox: {0}
uninstall_subtitle: Firefox and MyFox will be removed
uninstall_remove_profile: Also delete the profile (bookmarks, history, passwords)
uninstall_remove_profiles: Also delete the MyFox profiles (bookmarks, history, passwords)
uninstall_restore_sync: Move the Firefox account back to {0}
err_restore_sync_in_use: Close the Firefox that has {0} open, or don't move the account back.
err_profile_ambiguous: Several profiles are called {0}; give the ID: {1}
err_no_space: Not enough space in {0}: the profile needs {1} MB.
cmd_command: Whether the «firefox» shell command runs this Firefox (on, off; alone: show)
progress_command: Setting up the firefox shell command…
command_subtitle_on: The «firefox» shell command will run this Firefox:
command_subtitle_off: The «firefox» shell command will no longer run this Firefox:
command_off_done: Done: the firefox shell command is off.
command_is_on: The firefox shell command is on: {0}
command_is_off: The firefox shell command is off.
command_replaces: {0} already exists ({1}); it is kept as {2} and put back when the command is turned off.
command_not_in_path: {0} is not in PATH, so «firefox» won't find it yet; it usually is after logging in again.
command_shadowed: «firefox» will still run {0}: it comes before {1} in PATH.
command_restore: Put back the firefox it replaced ({0})
command_backup_taken: {0} is someone else's, and {1} is already taken: move one of them away first.
cmd_profile: Profiles: list, new, import, apply the tweaks, use, remove
cmd_profile_list: MyFox's profiles and the ones it could use (--all: every Firefox's)
profile_usage: Usage: myfox profile list [--all] [--json] | new [--use] | import <ID|folder> | apply <ID> | use <ID> | remove <ID>
profile_list_hidden: Other Firefoxes' profiles not shown: {0}. All of them: {1}
cmd_profile_new: A new empty profile with the tweaks
cmd_profile_import: Copy another Firefox's profile into a new MyFox one
cmd_profile_apply: Apply the tweaks to a profile
err_profile_foreign: «{0}» is another Firefox's profile: MyFox only imports it. Run: {1}
err_profile_open: Close the Firefox that has «{0}» open first.
err_profile_pin_failed: Couldn't make this Firefox open the profile: Firefox didn't start.
err_profile_no_tweaks: MyFox was installed without the tweaks: there are none to apply.
err_profile_not_created: «{0}» wasn't created by MyFox: MyFox doesn't delete it.
err_profile_used: «{0}» is the one this Firefox opens: first make it open another one ({1}).
err_profile_downgrade: The profile was last opened by Firefox {0}, newer than this one ({1}): it may not work right. To go ahead at your own risk, tick that.
profile_opt_use: This Firefox opens it from now on
profile_opt_downgrade: Import it although Firefox {0} last opened it (this one is {1}), at my own risk
profile_apply_subtitle: The tweaks, themes and bookmarklet styling go into the profile
profile_use_subtitle: This Firefox will open this profile
profile_remove_subtitle: Its bookmarks, history and passwords are deleted with it
profile_import_subtitle: A copy of it becomes a new MyFox profile; the original stays
